links.outcome: 30- and 120-day all-cause mortality and discharge mRS before vs after AI triage implementation
links.effect: 30-day mortality 27.7% vs 17.5% (p=0.004); 120-day 31.8% vs 21.7% (p=0.017); mRS at discharge 3.2 vs 2.8 (p=0.044) post-AI vs pre-AI.
links.quote: The 30- and 120-day all-cause mortality were significantly reduced in the post-AI group when compared to the pre-AI group (27.7% vs 17.5%; p = 0.004 and 31.8% vs 21.7%; p = 0.017, respectively).

screen.reason: The study evaluates the real-world clinical impact (pre- vs post-implementation mortality and morbidity) of deploying an AI triage and prioritization tool for intracranial hemorrhage detection, but it does not compare specific deployment practices or safeguards.
